# Public Page Runtime Surface

<!-- Generated by scripts/v3-catalog/generate.mjs. DO NOT EDIT. -->

Every Page Registry page an extension can target at runtime, with the body views and
layout values it accepts and the regions it exposes. `views` are the body sources a
`theme.json` page may declare; `replaceable` means a theme or plugin contribution can
replace the Core page; `virtual` pages have no path of their own (error boundaries and
similar) and are reached by the render path rather than a URL.

Views: `component`, `schema`, `template`. Layouts: `bare`, `site`.
